messages:
ashley_support: Hey team — customer on acct acme-inc reports repeated 502s when hitting /v1/chat and says latency spikes before the error. They included a request id: req_0a1b2c3d. Can ops take a look?

devin_engineer: On it. Can you paste the exact curl they used and the timestamp? Need to repro.

ashley_support: Timestamp from their app logs: 2026-03-15T18:42:11Z. Curl they sent (contains PII so I'll paste sanitized):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \n  -H "X-Request-ID: req_0a1b2c3d" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<REDACTED_PROMPT>"}],"max_tokens":300}' \n  --compressed
```

ashley_support: They said the prompt contains customer names and order numbers — asked us not to share raw text. They attached a debug bundle we need to pull: debug_bundle_1815001234.tar.gz (S3 link internal).

samir_oncall: I pulled the bundle. Logs show repeated 502 at the gateway, then a 504 from the model pool. Stack snippet: `gateway: downstream handshake timeout -> model-pool: timeout waiting for response`. Looks like request queued then evicted.

devin_engineer: Thanks. Two threads: 1) repro to confirm behavior, 2) sanitize the prompt so we can store repro with no PII. For repro, can we get a minimal prompt that still triggers the path? Ashley, ask customer if they can run this minimal repro (no PII):

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "X-Request-ID: req_test_repro_181500" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Order status check for ORDER_ID_RED_1"}],"max_tokens":50}'
```

devin_engineer: If that reproduces, we can iterate on sequence length and concurrency. If not, we'll need them to produce a sanitized bundle with mapping (original->redacted tokens).

ashley_support: I asked them to run the minimal curl and to upload the sanitized bundle. They responded with a sanitized prompt mapping like: "Order #12345" -> "ORDER_ID_RED_1", "alice@acme.com" -> "EMAIL_RED_1". They attached a small mapping.csv.

pii-redactor-bot: Quick reminder: when uploading bundles to the internal bucket, replace all email regex matches with EMAIL_REDACTED and phone numbers with PHONE_REDACTED. Do NOT upload unredacted .log or .json files.

taylor_cs: Customer also mentioned unexpected billing token error right before the time window: `401 invalid_token` in their app logs from 18:41:50Z to 18:42:05Z, then the 502s. Could be correlated.

samir_oncall: I checked token-service logs: transient auth backend error at 18:41:48Z. There was a short spike of 5xxs for the auth microservice. It could cascade.

devin_engineer: Ok, ops: can you attach the raw gateway traces around req_0a1b2c3d and the model-pool request ids. Ops, please scrub any user text in the trace before sharing in ticket. Use placeholders: <EMAIL_1>, <ORDER_1>.

ops-bot: Trace export ready: traces/2026-03-15/gateway-req_0a1b2c3d.log (redacted). Uploaded to internal/triage/1815001234/gateway-req_0a1b2c3d.log.

ashley_support: I downloaded and checked — confirm redaction looks ok. There is still a mention of a full email in one span (forgot to mask). I'll re-run scrubbing script.

devin_engineer: For the sanitized repro bundle we need: 1) sanitized prompt text, 2) mapping.csv mapping redacted tokens to placeholders (kept only in local private bucket), 3) minimal curl that reproduces. Please avoid including full customer tokens or API keys.

ashley_support: Customer uploaded a second bundle with mapping.csv stored only in their bucket and a sanitized request log named requests_sanitized_181500.log. They confirm no PII in that file.

samir_oncall: I ran the minimal repro against staging and saw a 502 at concurrency 8 with max_tokens 300. Could be a queue eviction threshold. Devin, can you check model-pool eviction policy for that model and this sequence length?

devin_engineer: Will look. Also want to correlate with the auth spike — if token retries caused bursts, that could overflow the pool. We'll instrument an additional metric and consider a fallback to smaller model variant on queue pressure.

taylor_cs: Customer wants ETA on fix and whether billing anomalies will be refunded — asking for status.

ashley_support: For now I told them: "We're investigating root cause (possible auth-induced cascade) and will provide a timeline after we confirm repro. I've asked for permission to run sanitized repro on their data in staging."

devin_engineer: Action items: *devin* check eviction configs and reproduce on staging with their sanitized bundle (req_test_repro_181500). *samir* correlate auth spikes to gateway queue depth. *ashley* confirm the mapping file is stored only in the customer's private S3 and not in the ticket. We'll update customer in 4 hours.

ashley_support: Noted. I'll also remind them they can request a temporary scrubbing script we provide to help generate sanitized bundles. I attached the script snippet in DM. :thumbsup: 

pii-redactor-bot: Approved scrub checklist applied to uploaded bundle. No PII detected in requests_sanitized_181500.log.

devin_engineer: Thanks all — I'll post findings here once I check the eviction and run the repro.

ashley_support: Closing loop for now, will ping when customer replies or we confirm repro. :eyes:
